subject: Locked out after changing phones and email
body:
Hi there,

I'm hoping someone can help, because I've gone around in circles for two days. Last week I changed jobs, so I lost access to my old work email, and I also got a new phone. I don't think I have 2FA on (at least I never set it up), but when I try to log in with my password it says "incorrect password", and when I click "forgot password" the reset link goes to my old work email, which I can no longer open.

I've been a paying customer on the Personal plan for three years, and all my freelance projects are in this account. I can confirm my identity with the last four digits of my card, my billing address, or anything else you need. The old email was dmitri.volkov@kestrelsoft.com, and I'd like to switch the account to dmitri.volkov.pm@gmail.com.

I have a client deadline on Thursday, so I'd really appreciate a quick response.

Thank you,
Dmitri

subject: Login fails only on company network
body:
Hello,

We have a strange issue that's affecting only some of our staff. When people connect to our office network (we use a Fortinet firewall with SSL inspection), the login page loads, but after they enter their credentials they get "Something went wrong, please try again". The same people can log in fine from home or on their phones over 4G. It started on Monday; nothing changed on our side as far as our network team can tell.

Our IT team captured a HAR file and saw the POST to /auth/session returning a 403 with an empty body. We suspect a new security check on your side is rejecting requests that come through our proxy, perhaps because of a certificate or header issue.

About 40 of our 55 staff work from the office, so this is disruptive. Could you tell us whether anything changed in your login flow, and whether there's a list of domains or IPs we should exempt from SSL inspection?

Regards,
Karen O'Doherty
IT Manager, Lough Derg Engineering

ok so this is getting ridiculous. i have tried to log in maybe 20 times today. first it said my password was wrong so i reset it. the reset email came, i set a new password, it said success. then i tried to log in with the new password and it said wrong password AGAIN. so i reset it again. same thing. i tried chrome, firefox, my phone, my wife's laptop. every single time the reset "works" and then the new password doesn't. i'm not making typos, i'm copying it from my password manager. is your system just not saving new passwords?? my email is t.brennan@brennanplumbing.ie and i need to get into my quotes before tomorrow morning

subject: Account locked - business critical
body:
Good morning,

My account was locked last night after several failed login attempts. I believe a former assistant, who still had an old password saved on her laptop, triggered the lockout while trying to access our shared calendar. I've since confirmed that nobody else has my current password, so I don't think this is a security issue, just a stale password.

The lockout message says to wait 24 hours, but I run a small accounting practice, and all of my client deadlines for this week are tracked in your app. We have a tax filing due tomorrow for three clients, and I can't see my task list.

Could you please unlock the account manually? I'm happy to verify my identity by phone, and I'll change my password immediately once I'm in. The account is registered to eleanor.pryce@prycetax.co.uk.

With thanks,
Eleanor Pryce
Pryce Tax & Accounts

subject: Login problem after browser update
body:
Since Chrome updated itself to version 131 yesterday, I can't log in anymore. I type my email and password, the button spins for a second, and then I land back on the empty login form. No error message at all. I cleared cookies and cache, disabled all extensions, and tried an incognito window: same result. Firefox and Safari both work fine on the same computer, so for now I'm using Firefox. But our whole company is standardised on Chrome, and I suspect others will hit this as their browsers update over the next few days.

Is this a known issue with the new Chrome version? Maybe something to do with third-party cookie changes? My email is h.yamada@sakura-trading.jp in case you want to check the logs.

subject: Authenticator codes never work after travel
body:
Hi,

I travel a lot for work, and I've noticed a pattern: whenever I land in a new time zone, my authenticator codes are rejected for the first few hours. It happened in Singapore last month, in Dubai two weeks ago, and today in New York. The codes in my app (Authy) look normal, and they work for every other service I use. After a while, sometimes after restarting my phone, they start working again.

Today it's worse. It's been six hours and I still can't log in, and I have a board meeting presentation stored in the app that I need in two hours. I have my backup codes somewhere, but not with me.

Can you temporarily disable 2FA on my account so I can get in, and can you tell me whether there's a time-sync issue on your side? My account email is richard.okafor@okaforventures.com.

Thanks,
Richard

subject: Enforcing 2FA broke our shared kiosk account
body:
Hello support team,

Last week our admin turned on "Require two-factor authentication for all members" in the security settings. That's what our insurer requires, so we're glad the option exists. However, we have one account that's used on a shared tablet at our warehouse reception. Delivery drivers use it to check in and view their pickup tasks. Nobody carries the phone that the 2FA codes go to, so the tablet has effectively been locked out since Friday, and the reception staff have gone back to a paper sign-in sheet.

Is there a way to exempt a single account from the 2FA requirement, or to use a hardware key that stays attached to the tablet? Alternatively, is there a better way to set up a kiosk-style login for shared devices? We have about 30 deliveries a day, so we'd like to sort this out quickly.

Workspace ID: ws_48815

Thanks,
Marcus Feld
Warehouse Operations

Hi, I'm writing on behalf of my father, who is 78 and not very technical. He uses your app to keep track of his volunteer work at the church. A few months ago, one of the younger volunteers set up "two step verification" on his account using his old mobile phone. Last week the phone stopped working and he bought a new one, and now the app keeps asking him for a six-digit code he doesn't have. He has no idea what backup codes are, and I couldn't find any written down at his house. I'm with him now and can answer any security questions. His email address is george.whitfield1946@btinternet.com. Could you please turn off the two step thing, or help us set it up on his new phone? He's quite upset because he can't see the rota for this Sunday. Thank you so much for your patience.

subject: SAML SSO config - attribute mapping issue
body:
Hi,

We've been configuring SAML SSO between our Keycloak instance and your application for the past week, and we're stuck on attribute mapping.

The authentication itself works: users are redirected to Keycloak, log in, and come back. But every user lands in your app with the display name "undefined undefined" and no department. In Keycloak, we're sending firstName, lastName and department as SAML attributes with the basic name format. According to your docs, the expected attribute names are "first_name", "last_name" and "department", so we added mappers for those as well, but nothing changed.

We also noticed that when a user's department changes in Keycloak, it isn't updated in your app on the next login. Is attribute sync only on first login (JIT), or on every login?

Could someone from your identity team look at our configuration? We're happy to share a sample SAML assertion, with sensitive values redacted. Org ID 58302.

Best,
Jonas Richter
Identity & Access Management, Vireo Systems GmbH

subject: SCIM deprovisioning deleted user content
body:
Hello,

We connected Azure AD SCIM provisioning two weeks ago. Yesterday, someone in our HR team accidentally removed a whole security group (about 35 people) from the enterprise app assignment in Azure. They fixed it within 30 minutes, but by then SCIM had already deprovisioned all 35 users in your system.

When they were re-provisioned, they came back as new, empty accounts. Their tasks now show "Deactivated user" as the assignee, their private projects are gone, and their personal settings reset. The users are the same people with the same emails, but your system treats them as different accounts.

We need two things: first, can the old accounts be merged back into the new ones, or the old accounts reactivated so their content and assignments come back? Second, is there a setting to make SCIM deprovisioning suspend users instead of deleting them, so this can't happen again?

This affects our entire finance department during month-end close, so it's urgent for us.

Org ID 90155
Maria Santos, IT Systems Administrator

subject: SSO setup for multiple subsidiaries
body:
Dear team,

We're a holding company with four subsidiaries, each with its own Azure AD tenant. All four currently use your product in a single Enterprise workspace, with password login. We'd like to move everyone to SSO, but each subsidiary has to authenticate against its own tenant.

Our questions:
1. Can a single workspace have several SAML identity providers, routed by email domain (@alder.com, @birchcap.com, @cedarlogistics.com, @dunmore.co.uk)?
2. If yes, can we enforce SSO for three of the domains while the fourth keeps password login during a transition period?
3. How does SCIM work when there are multiple IdPs? Can each tenant provision its own users?

We'd like to begin the rollout next month, so any guidance or a call with a solutions engineer would be appreciated.

Kind regards,
Philippa Moore
Group IT Director, Alder Holdings
Org ID 33190

Our Google Workspace SSO was working perfectly for about a year. This morning, every user who tries to log in gets sent to Google, picks their account, and then sees an error page on your side that says "SSO_ERR_17: Signature validation failed". Nobody on our side has touched the SSO configuration. Our Google admin says the SAML app certificate in Google was automatically renewed last night because it was about to expire, so I'm guessing we need to upload the new certificate to your side. But the SSO settings page is only accessible to admins who are logged in, and all our admins log in through SSO, so we're stuck. We have about 70 people who can't access anything right now. Can you either upload the new certificate for us (I can send it) or temporarily enable password login for our admin account (it-admin@hollowtree.edu)? Workspace hollowtree.ourapp.com.

subject: Notification preferences keep getting overwritten
body:
Hi,

I've spent a good amount of time setting up my notification preferences exactly the way I like: email for assignments and mentions only, push notifications for due-date reminders, and nothing for comments on tasks I'm just following. It works for a few days, and then I suddenly start receiving everything again. When I check my settings, they've been reset to the defaults.

This has happened three times in the past month. I noticed it seems to happen right after I'm added to a new project. Could adding someone to a project override their personal notification settings with the project's defaults? If so, is there any way to make my personal settings take priority? Otherwise I'm fighting an inbox of 200 emails a day, which defeats the point of the tool.

My account email is lena.hoffmann@brightpath.de.

Thanks for any help,
Lena

subject: Changing my name after marriage
body:
Hello,

I recently got married and changed my surname, and I'd like to update it everywhere in my account. I changed the display name in my profile, which worked. But my login email still has my old surname (h.kowalski@verdant-design.com), and our IT department has now set up a new address for me (h.adeyemi@verdant-design.com). The old one will be deactivated at the end of the month.

I'd like to change my login email to the new address without losing my projects, my task history, or my place in our company workspace. When I try to change it in settings, it says a verification email will be sent to the new address, but nothing ever arrives. Our IT team says your emails might be getting caught in quarantine, but they can't find anything.

Could you help me make the change, or tell me what else to try? I'd rather not wait until the old address stops working.

Thanks,
Hannah

Hello, I would like some help with my account settings please. I am from Brazil and I set my language to Portuguese, but some parts of the application are still in English, for example the date picker and the notification emails. Also, the dates are shown as month/day/year, but in Brazil we use day/month/year, and this caused a mistake last week when I thought a deadline was on 3 April but it was actually 4 March. I looked in the settings for a date format option but I could only find language and time zone. Is there a way to change the date format separately? And can the emails also come in Portuguese? Thank you very much for your help, and sorry for my English. My email is carla.menezes@uol.com.br

subject: Workspace permissions overhaul
body:
Hi team,

Our company has grown from 20 to about 110 people in the last year, and our workspace permissions have become a mess. Right now almost everyone is an admin, because that was the easiest way to give people access early on. Our auditor has flagged this, and we need to fix it before our SOC 2 audit next quarter.

What we'd like to end up with: a handful of admins in IT; team leads who can manage their own team's projects and members but nothing else; regular members who can only see the projects they're invited to; and contractors who can only see one or two projects.

Could you advise on the best way to set this up with your roles? Specifically, is there a "team lead" or "project admin" role, or do we need Enterprise for custom roles? And is there a bulk way to demote 90 admins to members without clicking through each profile?

Workspace ID: ws_60072

Thanks,
Owen Carlisle
IT Operations

subject: Ownership transfer - founder has left
body:
Hello,

Our co-founder, who created our workspace five years ago and is listed as the owner, left the company last month on good terms but is now travelling and very hard to reach. As a result, nobody can change our billing details, upgrade our plan, or delete old projects, which are all owner-only actions as far as we can tell.

I'm the CEO and currently an admin. I have the company's registration documents, a letter on company letterhead confirming my role, and I can get an email from our co-founder confirming the transfer if you absolutely need it, though it might take a week or two.

What's the process for transferring ownership in this situation? The workspace is lighthouse-games.ourapp.com, the current owner's email is j.whitlock@lighthousegames.io, and mine is a.moreno@lighthousegames.io.

Thank you,
Ana Moreno
CEO, Lighthouse Games

We just onboarded a large client who wants 25 of their people to have access to the three projects we run for them. They should be able to comment and upload files, but not see our other clients' projects or our internal projects. Last time we did this with a smaller client, we accidentally added the guests as full members and they could see everything for about a day before we noticed. I'd like to get it right this time. What's the correct way to set this up: guests, a separate workspace, or something else? Do guests count against our seat limit? And can I invite all 25 at once from a list instead of one by one? Our workspace ID is ws_83341. Thanks in advance, we're a bit nervous after last time.

subject: Request to close company account
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I'm writing as the managing director of Fielding & Rowe Ltd to formally request the closure of our company account and the deletion of our workspace.

The company is being wound up following my business partner's retirement, and we'll cease trading on the 31st of this month. We have already downloaded the data we need to keep for our records. Please:

1. Cancel our subscription with effect from the 31st, with no further charges after that date.
2. Permanently delete our workspace (fielding-rowe.ourapp.com) and all associated data after the 31st.
3. Send written confirmation once the deletion is complete, for our liquidator's file.

If you need any documentation from me to action this request, please let me know.

Yours faithfully,
Graham Fielding
Managing Director, Fielding & Rowe Ltd

subject: Delete my account - long story
body:
Hi,

So, a bit of background: I signed up a couple of years ago when I was trying to get my small candle business organised. It worked great for a while, but the business didn't take off, and I've gone back to a regular job. I stopped paying last year, so I think I'm on the free plan now.

I keep getting emails from you, which is a sad reminder every time, and honestly I'd just like to close that chapter. I don't need to download anything. Could you delete my account completely, including all the old projects and lists? I tried to find a delete button in settings but only saw "deactivate", and I'm not sure whether that removes everything or just hides it.

My email is poppy.harrington@icloud.com.

Thanks for being a nice product during a hopeful time!
Poppy

I need to close the account for our old nonprofit project. The nonprofit merged with a bigger organisation six months ago, and all the work has moved to their systems. The workspace is still there with about two years of volunteer coordination data. The problem is that the person who set it up has moved abroad and I'm not sure she's still the owner. I'm an admin. Can I delete the workspace myself, or does it need to be the owner? And before it's deleted, is there anything we need to do about the volunteers' personal data (names, phone numbers) stored in tasks? We want to make sure it's all gone properly. Workspace ID ws_14402.

subject: Please delete test accounts
body:
Hello,

During our evaluation last year, our IT team created 14 test accounts with made-up email addresses on our domain (test1@corvid-analytics.com through test14@corvid-analytics.com) to try out permissions and SSO. These accounts are still in our workspace, and it turns out they count toward our paid seats: we've been paying for 14 extra seats for about eight months without realising.

We'd like all 14 accounts deleted permanently. We can't do it ourselves because the accounts were never activated, so they don't show a remove option in the members list. We'd also like to understand whether we can get a credit for the seats we were charged for, but the deletion is the priority.

Workspace: corvid-analytics.ourapp.com

Thanks,
Niamh Gallagher
IT Administrator

subject: Charged three times for one upgrade
body:
Hello,

I upgraded our workspace from Pro to Business on Tuesday. The checkout page froze after I clicked "Confirm", so I refreshed and tried again. It froze again, so I tried a third time, and then it finally showed a success message.

Today I checked our company credit card statement and see three separate charges of $336.00 from you, all on Tuesday, a few minutes apart. Our workspace shows only one Business subscription, so it looks like the first two attempts charged the card even though they didn't complete.

Could you please refund the two extra charges ($672.00 total)? Our finance team is asking about it, and the card has a monthly limit that we're now close to. I've attached nothing, since this form doesn't allow attachments, but I can forward the card statement if needed.

Workspace ID ws_50932, invoice for the real charge: INV-64517.

Thanks,
Simone Laurent

I need someone to explain this bill to me because I don't understand it at all. We've been paying $120 a month for our team of 10 for over a year. This month we were charged $385. When I look at the invoice, there's a line for "Seat true-up" of $210 and another for "Storage overage" of $55. Nobody told us about a true-up, and we didn't add any people as far as I know. As for storage, I didn't even know there was a limit. Nobody warned us we were near it. This feels like a surprise bill, and I'd like it reversed, or at least explained properly before we pay anything more. Our account is acct_tr0u55 and the invoice is INV-64802. I'm the office manager, not a tech person, so please explain it simply.

subject: Annual renewal at wrong price
body:
Dear billing team,

Our annual subscription renewed on the 3rd at $5,880 for 35 seats. Last year we negotiated a price of $12 per seat per month with your sales representative, David Chen, as part of a two-year agreement. That should come to $5,040 for the year. The renewal was charged at the standard list price of $14 per seat instead.

I've attached the... well, I can't attach it here, but I have an email from David dated 14 October last year confirming the two-year pricing. I'm happy to forward it.

Please correct the renewal charge and refund the difference of $840. Please also make sure next year's renewal is set up at the agreed price, so we don't have to raise this again.

Account: acct_mv3519
Invoice: INV-64330

Regards,
Francesca Moretti
Finance Manager, Moretti Viaggi S.r.l.

subject: Charged after cancelling during trial
body:
Hi,

I signed up for the free trial on the 1st and entered my card details because the sign-up form required them. On the 10th, I went into billing and clicked "Cancel trial". I got a confirmation message and an email saying my trial had been cancelled and that I wouldn't be charged.

Yesterday, on the 15th, when the trial would have ended, I was charged $49 for the first month of the Pro plan anyway. I've forwarded the cancellation confirmation email to billing@ as well.

I'm a student and $49 is a lot for me, so I'd really appreciate a quick refund. I haven't logged in since cancelling. My email is jaylen.brooks@umich.edu.

Thank you,
Jaylen

This is my third message about this. In March you charged me for 12 seats when I had 8. I was told it would be corrected. In April the same thing happened, and I was promised a refund for both months that never came. Now it's May and I've been charged for 12 seats AGAIN. That's $48 a month in overcharges, $144 total, plus I've wasted hours of my time. I'm starting to think nobody reads these messages. I want the three overcharges refunded, the seat count fixed permanently, and some kind of confirmation that someone has actually looked at the account. Previous ticket numbers are #55120 and #57002. Account email: mark.ellison@ellisonsigns.com.

subject: Refund request - business closed
body:
Hello,

I'm writing to ask for a partial refund on our annual subscription. We paid $1,440 in February for a year of the Business plan for our small restaurant group (three locations, about 12 staff using the app for scheduling and supplier orders).

Unfortunately, due to a fire at our main kitchen in June, we've had to close two of the locations and scale the business right down. We haven't used the app since July, and we won't need it for the foreseeable future. I understand annual plans are usually non-refundable, but I'm hoping you might make an exception given the circumstances, even a prorated refund for the remaining months would help a great deal right now.

Our workspace is ferraro-kitchens.ourapp.com and the original invoice is INV-49903.

Thank you for considering this,
Antonio Ferraro

Hi, so a couple of months ago I bought the Business plan because the website said it included the client portal, which was the only reason I upgraded from Pro. It turns out the client portal only allows 3 clients on Business, and you need Enterprise for more. That wasn't mentioned anywhere on the pricing page when I bought it (I checked the Wayback Machine, and the note about the limit was added last month). I have 11 clients, so the portal is useless to me. I've been paying the extra $10 a month per seat for 4 people for 2 months, for a feature I can't use. I'd like a refund of that difference ($80) and to be moved back to Pro. I'm not trying to be difficult, I just think it's fair. Account: acct_cp4402.

subject: Refund for duplicate workspace subscription
body:
Hello,

I'm the office manager at a dental practice. It turns out two of our staff independently signed up for your Pro plan last year, each creating a separate workspace and each paying with a different company card, without knowing about the other. We only discovered this during our annual expense review.

We've now moved everyone into one workspace (dentalcare-plus.ourapp.com) and would like to close the other one (dcp-scheduling.ourapp.com). The duplicate subscription has cost us $39 a month for 11 months.

Would you consider refunding some or all of the duplicate charges? It was an honest mistake, and we've only ever used one workspace properly. The duplicate was barely touched after the first week.

Many thanks,
Ruth Okonjo
Practice Manager

subject: Moving from per-seat to Enterprise contract
body:
Hi,

We're currently on the Business plan with monthly billing for 140 seats, and the monthly invoices have become a headache for our finance team. We're also growing fast: we expect to be at about 220 people by the end of next year.

We'd like to move to an annual Enterprise contract, but we have a few requirements:
- A fixed price for up to 250 seats, with a true-up only once a year rather than monthly
- Invoice billing with 45-day payment terms
- Keeping our existing workspace, data and integrations exactly as they are

Is this the kind of change your team handles, or do we need to talk to sales? And if we switch mid-month, how would the current month's charges be handled?

Org ID 77045

Thanks,
Derek Asante
Head of Finance Operations

We're a seasonal business (garden centres) and we go from about 15 staff in winter to about 60 in spring and summer. At the moment we're paying for 60 seats all year round, which is a lot of money for seats nobody uses from November to February. Is it possible to lower our seat count for the winter and raise it again in March without losing the accounts, task history and assignments of the seasonal staff? When we tried removing people last year, their tasks all got reassigned to "deactivated user", which made a mess when they came back. Is there a way to pause seats, or a seasonal plan? Workspace greenacre-garden.ourapp.com.

subject: Upgrade blocked by payment error
body:
Hi,

I've been trying to upgrade our workspace from Starter to Pro for three days, but the checkout keeps failing with "We couldn't complete your upgrade. Please try again later." I've tried two different cards (a Visa and an Amex, both company cards that work everywhere else), two browsers, and two computers.

Our team hit the Starter project limit on Monday, so we can't create any new projects, and we've been putting new work into a spreadsheet as a stopgap. That's creating confusion. Workspace: bluewren-studio.ourapp.com
Contact: s.ahmadi@bluewrenstudio.com

Thanks,
Sara Ahmadi

subject: Cancellation - moving to competitor
body:
Hello,

I wanted to let you know that we'll be cancelling our Business subscription at the end of our current term on 30 November. We've decided to move to a competitor, mainly because of their native time-tracking-to-invoice feature, which is a better fit for how our consultancy bills clients.

This isn't a complaint: your product has served us well for three years, and several people on the team are sad to see it go. Please make sure auto-renewal is turned off, and confirm in writing that we won't be charged again.

I'd also appreciate knowing how long our data will stay available after the term ends, in case we need to look something up during the transition.

Account: acct_wh2201

Best regards,
William Hargreaves
Managing Partner, Hargreaves Consulting

I've been trying to cancel my subscription for two weeks and I'm losing my patience. The "Cancel subscription" button in billing takes me to a page asking why I'm leaving. I pick a reason and click continue, and then it offers me a discount. I click "No thanks, cancel", and it takes me back to the billing page, where it still says my plan is active and will renew on the 1st. I've done this at least five times. I also emailed billing@ last week and got an automated reply and nothing else. I don't want the discount, I don't want to pause, I just want to cancel. If this isn't done before the 1st, I'll be disputing the charge with my bank. Email: yvonne.castellanos@gmail.com

subject: Cancel subscription but keep the free workspace
body:
Hi team,

My small book club uses your app to organise our reading list and meeting schedule. When I signed up I chose the Pro plan by mistake, thinking it was needed for more than five members. Now I realise the free plan would have been fine for us, since we only use a single project.

Could you cancel the Pro subscription so I'm not charged again, but keep the workspace itself on the free plan? I don't want the club to lose the list we've built up over the year. If there's anything on the Pro plan that we'd lose, like file uploads or comments, I'd like to know first.

My email is margaret.l.chen@yahoo.com, and the workspace is called Tuesday Night Readers.

Thank you!
Margaret

subject: Payment keeps failing - European card
body:
Hello,

Our annual renewal payment has failed three times this week. Each time we get an email saying "Your payment could not be processed". Our bank (Rabobank, Netherlands) says they see the authorisation attempts, but they're being declined because 3D Secure authentication isn't being completed. The authentication request never reaches our banking app, so we can't approve it.

We've tried with the company Mastercard and with a Visa debit card, with the same result. The banner in the app now says our workspace will be downgraded to the free plan in four days, which would lock our 45 users out of Business features we depend on.

Could you either send us an invoice that we can pay by bank transfer (SEPA), or check what's wrong with the 3D Secure flow for Dutch cards?

Workspace ID: ws_38846

Met vriendelijke groet,
Pieter van den Berg
Office Manager

Hello! Our company changed banks last month, and I updated the payment method in billing to our new company card. The page said "Payment method updated". But this month's charge still went to the old card, which had already been closed, so the payment failed, and now we have an "Overdue" banner and a warning that the account will be suspended on Friday. When I look at billing, it still shows the old card ending 2291 as default. The new one (ending 7730) is listed but not marked default, and there's no button to make it default. Can you switch the default card to 7730 and retry the payment? We really don't want to get suspended, our whole scheduling system is in here. Workspace: redfern-physio.ourapp.com

subject: Account suspended - paid but still locked
body:
Hi,

Our account was suspended on Monday for non-payment. That was our fault: the card on file had expired and the reminder emails went to someone who's on leave. As soon as we noticed, on Tuesday morning, I paid the outstanding balance of $1,260 with a new card. The payment was successful. I have the receipt, and the card has been charged.

It's now Wednesday afternoon and the workspace is still suspended. All 30 of our users see a "This workspace is suspended" page and can't access anything. The billing page shows a zero balance.

Could someone please reactivate the workspace? We're a legal firm, and we have court deadlines tracked in there. Being locked out for another day could have serious consequences.

Workspace: kingsbridge-law.ourapp.com
Receipt number: RCPT-88213

Thank you,
Oliver Grant
Practice Manager

We're a small charity and our bank has just told us that from next month they'll stop allowing recurring card payments to overseas companies without a special mandate, which takes weeks to set up. Your subscription is our only overseas payment. Is there another way for us to pay? Maybe an annual invoice we can pay by international bank transfer, or PayPal, or a UK entity we can pay in GBP? Our subscription renews on the 5th of each month, and we're on the Pro plan with 8 seats. We don't want the account to lapse while we sort this out, because our volunteers use it every day. Account acct_ch4r1t.

subject: Need invoices reissued for audit
body:
Dear billing team,

Our annual audit is coming up, and our auditors have raised an issue with the invoices we've received from you over the past 18 months. They don't show our full legal entity name or our registered company number, and the VAT line doesn't specify the reverse-charge mechanism, which is required for B2B services supplied into the EU.

Could you please reissue all invoices from January of last year to date with the following details:
- Legal name: Aldergrove Medical Devices Ltd
- Company number: 11204587
- VAT number: IE3318456UH
- The note "VAT reverse charge - Article 196, Council Directive 2006/112/EC"

We'll need these within the next three weeks. Please also update our billing profile so future invoices include these details automatically.

Account: acct_am1120

Kind regards,
Siobhan Kearney
Financial Controller

Hi there, I'm a freelancer and I need to claim your subscription as a business expense for my tax return, which is due at the end of the month. The problem is that the receipts I get by email only show the amount and the date. They don't include my business name, address or ABN (Australian Business Number), which our tax office requires for claims over $82.50. I pay $19 a month, so the individual receipts are under the limit, but my accountant says I need a proper tax invoice for the full year. Can you generate one tax invoice covering July to June with my business details? Business name: Harbour Light Photography, ABN 51 824 753 556, address 12 Beach Rd, Manly NSW 2095. My login is sam@harbourlightphoto.com.au.

subject: PO number on invoices
body:
Hello,

We're a university department, and our accounts payable system automatically rejects any invoice that doesn't have a valid purchase order number printed on it. Our annual PO for your service this year is PO-2025-00418.

Your invoices don't seem to have a field for a PO number, and the last two invoices (INV-63770 and INV-64105) were rejected and are now showing as overdue in your system, even though we have the money set aside and want to pay.

Could you:
1. Reissue those two invoices with the PO number on them, and
2. Add the PO number to our billing profile so that future invoices include it automatically?

Please also confirm that the overdue status won't lead to a suspension while this gets sorted out.

Thank you,
Dr. Amelia Frost
Department Administrator, School of Earth Sciences

Our accountant wants a single statement showing every payment we've made to you since we became customers (about 3 years ago), with dates, invoice numbers, amounts, tax, and which plan and seat count each payment was for. We're being acquired, and the buyer's due diligence team is going through all of our vendor contracts. The billing page only lets me download invoices one at a time, and some of the older ones won't download at all (I get a "File not found" error for anything before last June). Can you produce a full statement for us, or at least fix the older invoice downloads? Account acct_dd0917, contact finance@tealbrook.io.

subject: Trial extension - evaluating for a large rollout
body:
Hello,

We're currently trialling your Business plan with a pilot group of 15 people from our operations department. If the pilot goes well, we'd roll out to our whole company of about 400 people next quarter.

The pilot has gone well so far, but our timeline has slipped: our IT security review, which has to approve any new SaaS tool, only started last week and usually takes three to four weeks. Our trial ends in five days, and we'd rather not lose the pilot group's momentum or their data while we wait.

Would you be able to extend our trial by 30 days? I'm also happy to talk to someone from your sales team about the wider rollout. It might make sense to discuss enterprise pricing in parallel.

Workspace: meridian-ops-pilot.ourapp.com

Best regards,
Rachel Kim
Director of Operations Excellence

Hi, honestly I feel a bit silly writing this, but I signed up for your trial two weeks ago and then my mum got sick and I had to fly home to take care of her, so I haven't opened the app since the first day. The trial ends tomorrow. I run a tiny online shop selling knitted things, and I was really hoping your app would help me keep track of custom orders, but I literally haven't had a chance to try it. Is there any way to get another week or two once I'm back home? I understand if not. My email is tilly.m.knits@gmail.com. Thank you for reading.

subject: Trial expired while waiting for PO
body:
Hi,

Our trial expired two days ago. We'd already decided to buy, and our procurement team is raising a purchase order for 30 Business seats, but our process requires the PO to be approved by two people, one of whom is on holiday until next Wednesday.

In the meantime, our team has been locked out of the workspace, and we have client deliverables planned in there for this week. Is there any way to reactivate the workspace for another 10 days until the PO comes through? I can send you written confirmation from our procurement team that the purchase is in progress.

Workspace: arcwright-studio.ourapp.com
Contact: l.bianchi@arcwright.studio

Thanks,
Luca Bianchi

We started a trial last Monday to test your product against the tool we use now, and our plan was to spend the second week testing integrations with our CRM and accounting software. Then our company was hit by a ransomware attack on Wednesday (not related to you, it came in through an old VPN), and all our IT staff have been on incident response since then. Nobody has had time to look at anything else. The trial ends this Sunday. Could it be paused or extended by two weeks, so we can do the evaluation properly once things calm down? We're still very interested. Workspace ID ws_71104.

subject: What happens to trial data if we don't buy yet
body:
Hello,

Our 14-day trial finishes on Friday. We'd like to buy, but our financial year ends on the 30th, and our CFO has asked us to hold all new software purchases until the new budget opens on the 1st. That means there will be about two weeks between the end of the trial and when we can actually pay.

Could you tell us what happens to our trial workspace during that gap? Will the data (about 40 projects and 600 tasks we've set up) be kept, and for how long? Or would it be simpler to extend the trial by two weeks so our team can keep working without interruption?

We're planning to buy 18 seats on Pro, possibly Business.

Workspace: pinecrest-realty.ourapp.com

Thanks,
Megan Doyle

subject: Recurring task bug causing duplicate client emails
body:
Hi,

We've found what looks like a serious bug with recurring tasks combined with automations.

We have a recurring task, "Send monthly report to client", that repeats on the 1st of every month, and an automation that sends an email to the client when that task is created. Since last month, the recurring task is being created twice on the 1st (a few seconds apart), so each client now gets two emails. This month about 60 clients received duplicate report emails. Several have asked whether we're having problems, which is embarrassing.

We've checked that there's only one recurrence rule and only one automation. We deleted the recurrence and set it up again, but the duplicates continue.

Can you look into this before the 1st of next month? Workspace ID: ws_44730.

Thanks,
Daniel Okafor
Client Services Lead

Something is wrong with how the app calculates the "% complete" on projects. Our big website redesign project shows 94% complete, but when I actually count, 42 out of 110 tasks are done, which is 38%. I think it's counting subtasks separately, or maybe it's counting archived tasks as complete, but either way the number is way off. The reason this matters is that our client can see this project through the client portal, and yesterday they emailed to congratulate us on being nearly finished. Now I have to explain that the number is wrong, which is not a conversation I want to have. Can you check how this is calculated and fix it, or at least tell me how to hide the percentage from the client view? Workspace ID ws_55190.

subject: Complete outage - all regions
body:
URGENT

Our entire organisation has been unable to use your platform since 07:45 UTC. That's our offices in London, Frankfurt and Singapore, over 600 users. The web app returns a 502 Bad Gateway error, the mobile apps show "Unable to connect", and the API returns 503 for every request, which has also stopped our automated order-processing pipeline.

Your status page still shows "All Systems Operational", which is causing confusion internally, because our staff assume the problem is on our side. Our network team has confirmed our connectivity is fine and that other SaaS services work normally.

We need:
- Confirmation that you're aware of the incident
- An estimated time to resolution
- Updates at least every 30 minutes
- A formal incident report within 5 business days, as required by our Enterprise agreement

Org ID: 10044
Contact: +44 20 7946 0321 (NOC, 24/7)

Henrik Solberg
Head of IT Infrastructure

Is the whole thing down or is it just us? Nothing has loaded since about 20 minutes ago. At first it was slow, then the boards started showing "Failed to load", and now I just get a blank white page with your logo in the corner. Everyone in our office (about 25 people) has the same thing, on Wi-Fi, on phones, on laptops. We tried from someone's home internet too, same thing. Our whole day revolves around this app. Our dispatch team can't see which jobs are assigned, so we have engineers sitting in vans not knowing where to go. Please let us know what's happening and roughly how long. Workspace: fieldforce-hvac.ourapp.com

subject: Outage during our product launch
body:
Hello,

I'm writing during what might be the worst possible timing for an outage. We're a marketing agency, and today is the launch day for our biggest client's product. Our launch plan, with every social post, press release and ad scheduled by the hour, lives in your app. For the past 40 minutes, nobody on our team of 35 can open any project. We get "Something went wrong, please try again" on every page.

We're running from memory and screenshots right now, which is going about as well as you'd expect. The client is on a video call with us every hour.

Please tell me whether this is a known incident and when you expect it to be fixed. If there's any way to get a read-only export of a single project while the app is down, that would save us today.

Workspace: brightspark-agency.ourapp.com

Thanks,
Zoe Papadopoulos
Account Director

Our web app has been down in the EU region for at least the last half hour, and yesterday there was a similar outage in the afternoon for about an hour. Before that, two outages last week. I've lost count of how often I've refreshed your status page this month. Right now nobody in our Berlin office can work, and the company is starting to question whether we should keep paying for a tool that goes down several times a week. I'd like (1) an explanation of what is going on with reliability in the EU region, (2) an ETA for today's outage, and (3) to know whether you're planning any infrastructure changes to stop this happening. Org ID 62230.

subject: Performance degradation for large workspace
body:
Hi team,

Over the last two months, performance in our workspace has degraded to the point where our team is getting frustrated. Some numbers from our internal testing, all from the same office network:

- Opening the "All Projects" portfolio view: 18 seconds (it used to be 2-3)
- Loading a board with about 800 tasks: 12 seconds
- Searching for a task by name: 8-10 seconds
- Switching between projects in the sidebar: 4-5 seconds

We have about 350 users, about 1,200 active projects and roughly 180,000 tasks, including archived ones. I suspect our size is the problem, but we're on the Enterprise plan, and I'd expect it to handle a workspace like ours.

Is there anything on your side you can look at, like indexing or moving us to different infrastructure? And is there anything we should do on our side, like archiving old projects, to improve things?

Org ID: 88104

Thanks,
Tamsin Hughes
PMO Tools Lead

Since about a week ago the app has become painfully slow for me, but only in the afternoon. In the mornings everything is snappy, and by 2pm or so every click takes several seconds, typing in comments lags, and dragging cards on the board is jerky. I'm in Sydney, so my afternoon is night-time in the US and morning in Europe. I don't know if that's relevant. My colleagues here say the same thing. We've tested our internet: speed tests are fine, and other sites are fast. I don't think it's our computers either, since some of us have brand new laptops. Is there something happening on your side at those times, like maintenance or backups? It's making the second half of our workday really unproductive. Workspace ID ws_29034.

subject: Desktop app memory usage
body:
Hello,

Our staff use your desktop app for Windows, and we've been getting complaints that it makes their laptops unusable by the afternoon. I've done some testing: when the app is first opened, it uses about 400 MB of RAM. After four hours of normal use (about 15 projects open over the day, lots of switching between boards), it's at 3.2 GB, and CPU usage is spiking to 30-40% even when nobody is touching it.

Our standard laptop has 8 GB of RAM, so once the app is at 3 GB, together with Outlook and Teams, everything starts to crawl. Closing and reopening the app fixes it temporarily. It looks a lot like a memory leak.

We're on version 3.14.2. Is this a known issue, and is a fix coming? For now we've told staff to use the web version in the browser instead.

Thanks,
Kwame Mensah
IT Support Lead, Coastline Credit Union

subject: Data corruption after bulk edit
body:
Hi,

Yesterday afternoon, one of our project managers used the bulk edit feature to change the due date on about 120 tasks in our "Q4 Production" project. The operation seemed to succeed. But since then, strange things have been happening to those tasks: some show a due date in 1970, some have lost their assignee, and about 20 have duplicated themselves, with one copy showing the old due date and one the new.

Worse, the task history for those tasks only shows the bulk edit and nothing before it, so we can't see what the original values were.

This project runs our manufacturing schedule for the next three months, so the data being wrong has real consequences. Is there a way for you to restore the project to its state from before the bulk edit, around 3pm yesterday UTC?

Workspace ID: ws_63018

Thank you,
Laszlo Nagy
Production Planning Manager

I'm going a bit crazy here. I've noticed over the last few weeks that small changes I make aren't being saved: I tick off a checklist item, and when I come back the next day it's unticked; I change a priority from Medium to High, and later it's Medium again. Not every time, maybe one change in ten. At first I thought I was imagining it or that a colleague was changing things back, but I checked the activity log, and my changes don't even appear there. It's like they were never received. I work on a laptop that sometimes switches between office Wi-Fi and my phone hotspot during the day, if that matters. I'm now double-checking everything I do, which is exhausting. Can someone look into this? My email is b.oyelowo@stratagem-hr.com.

subject: Two-way Jira sync overwriting data
body:
Hi,

We've been using your two-way Jira Cloud integration for about six months without problems. Since last Thursday, it has started overwriting fields in the wrong direction.

When someone updates a task's status or description in your app, the change syncs to Jira correctly, but a few minutes later the old value from Jira is synced back and overwrites the new value in your app. So people are seeing their updates "undone" a few minutes after making them. Our engineering team, who work mainly in Jira, see the correct values; our product and design teams, who work in your app, see the old ones.

We've paused the integration to stop further damage, but that means the two teams are now out of sync. The integration settings show the conflict resolution as "most recent change wins", which is what we want.

Could you check the sync logs for our workspace? The integration ID is JIRA-SYNC-20417.

Thanks,
Ingrid Solheim
Product Operations

We rely heavily on your Salesforce integration: when a deal is marked Closed Won, it automatically creates an onboarding project from our template and assigns it to the account manager. It's worked beautifully for a year. Last week we closed 12 deals and only 4 onboarding projects were created. The other 8 just didn't happen, with no error in the integration log that I can see. The deals all look the same in Salesforce. Same record type, same owner field populated. Our customer success team didn't notice for several days, so we now have 8 new customers who didn't get their kickoff emails on time. Can you look into why the integration is skipping deals? Workspace ID ws_80021. Salesforce org ID 00D5g000004XyZ.

subject: Slack integration posting to wrong workspace
body:
Hello,

We have a slightly unusual setup: our company has two Slack workspaces (one for staff and one shared with clients, called Studio Connect), and we've connected your app to both, so that different projects post updates to different Slack workspaces.

Since the Slack integration update you released last week, all notifications, including internal ones, are being posted to the client-facing Slack workspace. That means internal discussions about budgets, staffing and client feedback have been posted in channels our clients can see. We noticed yesterday and disconnected the client workspace immediately, but some sensitive information was already visible to clients for several days.

We need to understand what happened, whether it has been fixed, and how to safely reconnect both workspaces with the right project-to-channel mapping.

Workspace: ember-and-oak.ourapp.com

Thank you,
Sophie Laurent
Studio Operations Manager

Our Google Calendar integration is behaving oddly. Every task with a due date is supposed to appear on the assignee's Google Calendar as an all-day event. For about half our team it works perfectly. For the other half, the events appear on the wrong day (one day earlier), and some of them have the title "[object Object]" instead of the task name. The people who have the problem all seem to be in time zones east of UTC (India, Australia, Singapore), and the people for whom it works are in the UK and the US. We've tried disconnecting and reconnecting the integration for a few affected people, with no change. It's causing missed deadlines because people plan their day from their calendar. Workspace ID ws_61128.

subject: HubSpot integration - contacts duplicated
body:
Hello,

We set up the HubSpot integration last month to link contacts and companies to projects in your app. Since then, every time a project is updated, the integration seems to create a new contact in HubSpot instead of linking to the existing one. Our marketing team discovered that HubSpot now has about 2,300 duplicate contacts, many with the same email address. That's messing up our email campaigns and reporting, and it has pushed us over our HubSpot contact tier limit, which will cost us money.

We've disconnected the integration for now. Could you tell us what's causing the duplicates, and whether there's a way to identify and clean up the contacts the integration created? We'd also like to know whether it's safe to reconnect.

Workspace ID: ws_37744

Thanks,
Chiara Russo
Marketing Operations Manager

subject: API: inconsistent results from task search endpoint
body:
Hi,

We're building an internal tool that uses the /v2/tasks/search endpoint to find tasks by custom field value. We're seeing inconsistent results: the same query, run several times in a row a few seconds apart, returns a different number of results each time, anywhere from 142 to 158 tasks. There are no changes to the underlying tasks during that time.

Our query is: POST /v2/tasks/search with {"filters": [{"field": "cf_client_code", "op": "eq", "value": "ACME"}], "limit": 200}.

We've also noticed that results sometimes include tasks where cf_client_code is empty, which shouldn't match.

Is the search endpoint eventually consistent, perhaps backed by a search index that lags behind? If so, is there a way to force a consistent read, or should we use the list endpoint with filtering instead? Example request IDs: req_71bc2e04, req_71bc2e91.

Thanks,
Aleksander Nowak
Senior Developer, Brightline Systems

We're getting really confused by your API authentication. We have an integration that was built by a contractor two years ago using what I think is an API key in the header (X-API-Key). Last week it stopped working with a 401, and your email said that legacy API keys are being deprecated and we need to move to OAuth or personal access tokens. The contractor is long gone, and I'm a product manager, not a developer, though I can read code a little. Can you tell me in plain terms what we need to change? Is it just swapping the key in the header for a new token, or do we have to rewrite the integration? And is there a grace period we can use to buy some time? Account acct_pm8821.

subject: Webhook delivery failures and retries
body:
Hello,

We use webhooks for all task events to feed our analytics pipeline. Last weekend our receiving endpoint was down for about 9 hours because of a cloud provider issue on our side. Once it came back up, we expected your system to retry the failed deliveries, as described in your docs (exponential backoff for up to 24 hours).

But we only received a small fraction of the missed events, roughly 300 out of an estimated 4,000 based on activity in the app during that window. The webhook status page in your developer settings now shows our webhook as "Disabled due to repeated failures", and we had to re-enable it manually.

Two questions: is there a way to replay the events from that 9-hour window? And can the auto-disable threshold be raised, or can we get an alert before a webhook is disabled?

Webhook ID: wh_4Kf92LmQx

Thanks,
Priya Nair
Data Platform Engineer

subject: Migrating 10 years of data from our old system
body:
Hello,

We're an engineering consultancy that has used a custom-built project database for the last 10 years. We're retiring it and moving everything to your platform. We have about 4,500 projects, 210,000 tasks, 1.2 million comments and about 800 GB of attachments.

We've tried the CSV import on a sample of 50 projects, and it works for the basic structure, but we lose the comments, the attachments, and the link between tasks and subtasks. The API looks like it could handle all of this, but at our volume we'd hit the rate limits quickly.

Would you be able to help with a migration of this size? Options we're considering: a temporary rate-limit increase for our API key during the migration, a bulk import service from your side (we're happy to pay), or a recommended partner who does these migrations.

Org ID 20771

Kind regards,
Michael Brandt
Head of IT, Brandt & Kessler Engineering

The CSV export is driving me mad. I need to send our monthly project status to our board, and I export the project to CSV and open it in Excel. First, the columns are in a different order every time I export. Second, the custom field columns have internal IDs as headers (like cf_8812) instead of the field names. Third, any description with a comma in it breaks the columns, so rows get split in the wrong place. I've been fixing it by hand for three months, and it takes me an hour each time. Is there an export option that gives consistent columns with proper headers, or am I doing something wrong? Workspace: coralbay-housing.ourapp.com

subject: Full export for legal hold
body:
Dear support team,

Our company is involved in litigation, and our legal counsel has instructed us to preserve all project data relating to a specific client for the period from January 2022 to the present. That includes tasks, comments, attachments, activity history, and the record of who viewed or edited what.

We need to produce a complete, forensically sound export of three specific projects (Hollis Tower Phase 1, Phase 2, and Snagging) for the lawyers. The standard export seems to include tasks and comments, but not the full activity or audit history, and attachments come as links rather than files.

Can you provide a full export of these projects, including audit logs and attachments, in a format suitable for legal review? If this is a paid service, please let us know the cost. Our counsel's deadline is in 14 days.

Org ID: 47730

Regards,
Catherine Walsh
General Counsel, Walsh Construction Group

subject: iOS app drains battery and gets hot
body:
Hello,

Several people in our field team have reported that since the latest iOS app update (version 6.1), their iPhones get noticeably hot and the battery drains much faster when the app is open. One colleague said her battery went from 100% to 30% in three hours of normal use, mostly checking tasks and adding photos to site reports. Before the update, the app barely registered in the battery usage stats.

In iOS settings, your app now accounts for 45-60% of battery usage for the people affected. Some have started closing it between uses, which means they miss push notifications for new assignments.

Affected devices so far: iPhone 13, iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 15, all on iOS 18. Background App Refresh is on for all of them. Is this a known issue with 6.1?

Workspace ID: ws_52018

Thanks,
Nathan Brooks
Field Operations Coordinator

The Android app has a really annoying problem with the keyboard. When I tap into a comment box near the bottom of a task, the keyboard pops up and covers the text box, so I can't see what I'm typing. The screen doesn't scroll up the way it does in other apps. I've tried rotating the phone and using a different keyboard (Gboard and SwiftKey), with the same result. I have a Samsung Galaxy A54 on Android 14, and my colleague with a Pixel 7 says the same happens to her. It makes writing anything longer than a few words almost impossible. We're a cleaning company, and our team leads use the app to write notes about each job, so it's a real pain for us. Workspace: sparkle-cleaning.ourapp.com

subject: Android app won't sync on company-managed phones
body:
Hi,

We recently enrolled all our company Android phones in Microsoft Intune for device management. Since then, your Android app on these phones installs fine, and users can log in, but nothing syncs. Boards are empty, and new tasks created on the phone never appear on the web. On personal (unmanaged) phones, the same users have no problems.

We suspect our Intune app protection policy is blocking something, possibly network access to certain domains or local storage, but our Intune admin can't work out which. Do you have documentation on the network endpoints the Android app needs, or a recommended app protection configuration for Intune? We have 85 field users waiting on this.

Org ID: 36621

Thanks,
Fatima Al-Rashid
End User Computing Lead

subject: Notification emails going to spam after domain change
body:
Hello,

We changed our company email domain last month from @harbourlinegroup.com to @harbourline.co as part of a rebrand. Since then, about half of our staff aren't receiving your notification emails. They're not in the inbox or the spam folder. Our Microsoft 365 message trace shows them being rejected at the gateway with the reason "SPF hard fail" on some messages and "DMARC policy reject" on others.

I noticed that some of your emails come from notifications@ourapp.com and others from a different sending domain, mail.ourapp-notify.com. The second one seems to be the one failing. Could your email team check your SPF and DMARC setup for that sending domain? It's also possible our new domain's security settings are stricter, but we'd need your list of sending IPs and domains to allowlist.

Org ID: 81123

Thank you,
Aidan Walsh
IT Infrastructure Lead

Our clients are complaining that the emails they get from your client portal ("A new file has been shared with you", "Your approval is needed") look like spam or phishing. The emails come from an address they don't recognise, the "View" button links to a long URL on your domain, and the subject lines have no mention of our agency's name. Two clients deleted approval requests thinking they were scams, and we missed a print deadline because of it. We're on Business, and I thought we could customise the sender name and add our branding to these emails, but I can't find the setting, and the help article I found describes a settings page that doesn't seem to exist anymore. How do we make these emails look like they come from us? Workspace: inkwell-creative.ourapp.com

subject: Scheduled report emails failing silently
body:
Hi,

We have six scheduled reports that email a PDF summary to our senior leadership every Monday at 7am. For the last three Mondays, they haven't arrived. There's no error anywhere. In the report scheduling screen, each one shows "Last sent: Monday 07:00 - Success". But the emails aren't in anyone's inbox, spam or quarantine, and our mail server logs show nothing received from your domain at that time.

Other notification emails, like mentions and assignments, arrive normally, so it doesn't look like a general block on our side.

Our CEO has noticed the missing reports and asked me what's going on, so I'd be grateful for a quick investigation.

Workspace ID: ws_40028

Thanks,
Louise Hartley
Executive Assistant to the CEO

Hi, I'm a secondary school teacher and I've started using your app to manage coursework projects with my students (they're 16-17). It's working well, but I have a few questions about how to set things up properly. I'd like each student to have their own project that only they and I can see, but I also want one shared project where I post announcements for everyone. I also want to be able to see at a glance which students are behind on their deadlines, without opening 28 separate projects. Is there a dashboard or a view that shows tasks across several projects at once? And can I make a template for the student projects so I don't have to set up the same 12 tasks 28 times? Sorry for all the questions, I'm new to this kind of tool.

subject: How to structure workspace for agency
body:
Hello,

We're a digital agency with about 40 staff, and we've just moved to your platform. We're trying to work out the best way to organise our workspace before everyone starts using it properly, because reorganising later will be painful.

We work with about 25 active clients at any time, each client usually has several projects running (website, SEO, social media, and so on), and each project involves people from different departments (design, dev, copy, account management). We'd also like to see workload across the whole agency, and to give clients access to only their own projects.

Should we have one project per client with sections for each workstream, or separate projects grouped into folders or portfolios by client? How do other agencies usually set this up? Are there any templates or guides specifically for agencies?

Thanks,
Rebecca Stone
Operations Director

subject: Feature request: approval workflows
body:
Hi team,

We've been using your product for about 18 months in our marketing department, and one thing we really miss is a proper approval workflow.

Right now, when a designer finishes a piece of work, they move the task to a "Needs Approval" column and @mention the approver in a comment. But there's no formal record of who approved what and when, no way to require approval from more than one person (for example the brand manager and legal), and no way to stop a task from moving to "Done" without approval.

What we'd love: a way to mark a task as requiring approval from specific people or roles; approvers can approve or reject with a comment; the task can't move forward until all approvals are in; and a clear approval history on the task.

Many of our competitors' users mention this feature, and it's the main reason our legal team still insists on a separate tool for final sign-off. Happy to be a beta tester if you build it.

Best,
Alicia Fernandes
Marketing Operations Manager

I have a feature request, and I'll explain the context so it makes sense. I manage a team of 12 support engineers who work in shifts across three time zones. We use your app to track support escalations, and each escalation needs an owner at all times. The problem is that when someone's shift ends, their open escalations need to be handed over to the next person on shift, and right now we do that manually by reassigning tasks, which is easy to forget. What I'd love is some kind of on-call or rotation feature: define a schedule (who's on shift when), and have tasks in a certain project automatically reassigned to whoever is currently on shift, with a note in the task history. Even a simpler version, an automation trigger based on time of day, would help a lot. Is anything like this planned?

subject: Product feedback after one year
body:
Hi,

We've now been using your product for a full year across our 60-person company, and I promised myself I'd send some structured feedback once we reached that milestone.

What works really well: the board view is intuitive, and people adopted it without much training; the Slack integration is excellent; and your support team has been responsive and friendly every time we've needed help.

What has been harder: reporting is limited, and our leadership team still exports to Excel to build the charts they want; permissions are confusing, and we've had a couple of incidents where people saw projects they shouldn't; and the mobile app lags well behind the web app, so our sales team, who are mostly on the road, feel like second-class users.

Overall, we're happy and will be renewing. I just wanted you to know which parts make the biggest difference to a company like ours.

Best regards,
Elena Petrova
COO

subject: Responsible disclosure - account takeover via email change
body:
Hello security team,

I'm reporting a vulnerability I found while evaluating your platform for my employer. I've only tested it against two accounts I created myself.

The issue: when a user changes their email address, the change takes effect right away, and a confirmation email is sent to the new address. No confirmation is required from the old address, and the user isn't asked for their current password. Combined with the fact that session cookies aren't flagged SameSite=Strict, an attacker who can get a logged-in user to visit a malicious page can use CSRF to change the victim's email to one the attacker controls. The attacker can then trigger a password reset to that address and take over the account.

I've written a proof-of-concept page that demonstrates the full chain against my own test account. I'd be glad to share it and a detailed write-up through a secure channel. I'll keep this confidential for 90 days, or until a fix is released, whichever comes first.

Best regards,
Tomás Herrera
Application Security Engineer

Hi, I'm not a professional security person, just a developer who uses your app, but I think I stumbled on something you should know about. I was looking at the network requests in my browser's dev tools (I was trying to debug our own integration) and I noticed that when I load a project, the response includes the email addresses and phone numbers of every member of the workspace, including people who aren't in that project and guests from other companies. None of that information is shown in the UI, so I don't think it's supposed to be sent to the browser at all. It means any guest can see the contact details of everyone in the workspace just by opening dev tools. I haven't done anything with the data. I just wanted to report it. Is there someone specific I should send details to?

subject: Security vulnerability in public share links
body:
Hello,

I'm a penetration tester, and during an authorised test for one of your customers (they've given me written permission to contact you), I found an issue with the public share link feature.

When a board is shared publicly, the link contains a token. If the owner later disables public sharing, the old link stops working in the browser, but the API endpoint behind it still returns the full board data, including tasks, comments and attachment URLs, when called directly with the old token. The token doesn't seem to be revoked server-side; only the front end checks whether sharing is enabled.

This means anyone who ever had a public link can keep reading the board indefinitely, even after the owner thinks it's private again. The customer considers this high severity.

I'd like to share the full technical details with your security team. Please let me know the best contact.

Regards,
Isabelle Martin
Senior Consultant, Clearwater Security

Hi, I'm reporting a potential security issue with your Chrome extension. I noticed that after I log out of your web app, the extension still has access to my account: I can still create tasks from the extension popup and see my project list. It looks like the extension keeps its own long-lived session token that isn't revoked on logout. For people who use shared or public computers, that means logging out of the website doesn't actually log them out. I tested this on two computers with the current version of the extension from the Chrome Web Store. I'm not sure whether this counts as a vulnerability or a design choice, but it surprised me and I thought you'd want to know. Happy to provide more details if needed.

subject: Unauthorised access by former contractor
body:
Hello,

We've discovered that a former contractor, whose engagement ended six weeks ago, has been accessing our workspace. We removed him as a member when his contract ended, but it turns out he'd created a personal access token for the API while he was working with us. Our logs show that token being used almost daily since he left, most recently yesterday, to read tasks and download attachments from our R&D projects.

We've now revoked the token, but we need your help with several things urgently: a full list of API calls made with that token after his removal date; confirmation of exactly which files were downloaded; and whether there are any other tokens or sessions still associated with his account.

We'll likely be taking legal action, so please preserve all relevant logs.

Org ID: 55840
Former contractor's email: d.harlan@freelance-dev.net

Regards,
Victoria Lang
Chief Information Security Officer

Something really weird just happened and I'm scared my account has been hacked. I got an email saying "Your password has been changed" at 3:14am, and I was definitely asleep. Then I got another email saying a new device was added for two-factor authentication. I can still log in with my old password somehow (maybe the change didn't go through?), and I've changed it again just now. But when I look at my security settings, there's a second authenticator app registered that isn't mine, and I can't remove it, the remove button gives an error. I have a lot of confidential client information in my projects. Please help me lock this down, and tell me whether anyone accessed my files. My account email is naomi.chikwanha@chikwanha-advisory.co.zw.

subject: Suspected account compromise - unusual task activity
body:
Hi,

I'm the admin of our company workspace. This morning several team members reported that tasks had been reassigned to a user none of us recognised, and that comments had been added to client projects asking clients to "update their payment details" via an external link. The comments were posted from the account of our sales director, who has been on annual leave with no laptop for the past week.

We've suspended his account and deleted the comments, but at least three clients may have already clicked the link. We need to know how the attacker got into his account, whether they accessed any other accounts, and a list of everything the compromised account did in the last seven days.

Workspace: larkspur-consulting.ourapp.com
Compromised account: m.adeyemi@larkspurconsulting.com

Thanks,
Joanna Reid
Operations Manager

subject: Data processing agreement and international transfers
body:
Dear Privacy Team,

We're a Swiss-based financial services firm, and we're currently reviewing our use of your platform as part of our annual vendor compliance review. Our Data Protection Officer has raised some questions we need answered before our renewal next month.

1. Could you provide your current Data Processing Agreement, including the Swiss addendum under the revised Federal Act on Data Protection (nFADP)?
2. Which of your sub-processors are located outside Switzerland and the EU, and what transfer mechanisms (SCCs, adequacy decisions) are in place for each?
3. Can you confirm whether any of your staff outside the EU or Switzerland can access customer data, for example for support, and under what circumstances?
4. Do you offer a data residency option that keeps all data, including backups, within Switzerland or the EU?

We'd appreciate a response within two weeks, as our compliance committee meets at the end of the month.

Kind regards,
Dr. Lukas Meier
Data Protection Officer, Alpenrose Capital AG

Hello, I'm writing because I recently found out that my former employer used your platform, and that tasks and comments about me, including some related to a disciplinary process, were stored there. I no longer work there and I'm in a legal dispute with them. Under GDPR, I'd like to know what personal data about me you hold, both as a user account (I had one under maria.gonzalez@freshway-foods.es) and in the content stored in their workspace. I understand that my former employer may be the data controller for the workspace content, but I'd like confirmation of what you hold directly, and guidance on how to request the rest. Please also make sure my data isn't deleted while this is ongoing, because it may be evidence.

subject: Data retention policy for deleted items
body:
Hi,

We're updating our internal data retention policy, and we need clear answers about how long your platform keeps data after it's deleted, so our documentation is accurate.

Specifically:
- When a user deletes a task, how long is it kept in the trash, and how long after the trash is emptied does it stay in your backups?
- When a workspace is deleted at contract end, how long until all data, including backups, is permanently destroyed?
- Are logs (access logs, audit logs) retained separately, and for how long?
- Can we ask for shorter retention periods, for example 30 days for backups, on the Enterprise plan?

Our policy has to reference these numbers explicitly, and our auditors will check them against your documentation.

Org ID: 60318

Thanks,
Helen Burke
Compliance Manager
